subject: Re: COSTAR kickoff: counterfactual forecasting for the platform
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and compute, as promised:

- Linnea Yamada 50% April-July, repro and training infrastructure (the conda env pin to pandas 1.5.3 for saved-data compatibility is annoying but handled; wandb logging is set up for all runs).
- Jorge Vidal 40%, feature-store integration spike.
- Amara Okafor 30%, data tooling - she's re-running the MIMIC-III semi-synthetic generation with data_gen_n_jobs=8 across seeds 17/43/44/91/95 so we're not blocked on the Zenodo tarball.
- Carmen Reyes is committed to COSTAR at 60% for the whole of July 2026 - she owns the MIMIC-III semi-synthetic evaluation and the final ablation grid, and July is exactly when that lands. I've told her to treat that as fixed.

Compute: ~96 A100s on titan-a100 in bursts, no reservation needed. I'll put the allocations in the OKR tool before the June 26 lock.

Alina
